synopsis: Siemens Simcenter appears in two distinct validation roles: vendor sensor-model validation using XenomatiX lidar BSDF, and full multibody machine modelling [f4342, f6454]. The cited sensor-model validations cover on-road targets, leaving their applicability to off-road targets unestablished by these facts [f4342]. Full multibody models with contact and a detailed plant support machine dynamics, actuator and failure analysis, and real-time co-simulation; Simcenter is among the commercial options listed [f6454]. However, no public benchmark was found comparing stopping-distance accuracy for Simcenter and the other named modelling options on the same production earth-moving machines, so the corpus does not establish comparative braking accuracy [f6561].

relations.note: Adds a comparative stopping-distance evidence gap to the listed machine-dynamics modelling options.
